constraints: Only visible (non-hidden) windows across all running processes (kernel or user) are returned.

overloadMerges.note: Autoparse defaulted windows to direction 'in', but the parameterTable arrow (←) shows it is filled in by the command (out), not supplied by the caller.

params.name: windows
params.description: Filled with the window reference numbers of the currently open, visible windows
If passed, floating windows are included in windows; if omitted, floating windows are ignored

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Fills windows with the reference numbers of all currently open, visible windows across all running processes, optionally including floating windows.
